description:
Welcome to our dedicated sports rug section—a collection of high-quality, fan-centric basketball and soccer rugs that bring your passion to practical and stylish home décor. Using high-density memory fabric, a non-slip rubber backing, and fade-resistant prints, we ensure each rug is durable, comfortable, and perfectly reflects the team/player spirit. From 80 x 120 cm team logo rugs to 150 x 200 cm jersey-inspired designs, we offer every sports enthusiast a decor that rivals the atmosphere of game day.


What Makes Us Unique

• High-density memory fabric + non-slip rubber backing for durability

• Fade-resistant high-definition printing (vibrant team colors, clear team logos)

• Three core product lines: Team logo rugs, player jersey rugs, and mascot rugs (regularly updated)

• Sizes tailored to fan needs (from small decorative rugs to large area rugs) for various space requirements


How to Earn Commission Through Affiliate Marketing

• Earn a base commission of 10% on every sale

• 30-day cookie validity

• Monthly reward tiers: Earn 12% commission on sales of $5,000 and additional bonuses on sales of $10,000

• Product samples and exclusive discount codes for content creators


How to Promote Us

• TikTok/Instagram Reels: Unboxing videos, men's space/bedroom rug pairings, before and after wrinkle removal

• Blog comments: Home decorating guides + exclusive discount codes

• Emails/Newsletters: Sports fan gift guides (ideal for playoffs and holidays)

• Live Stream: Create a Sports-Themed Room with Our Rugs Challenge


Other Information

• Worldwide shipping with full package tracking

• 24/7 customer support (wrinkle removal tips, returns, product inquiries)

• Monthly league member newsletter featuring the latest team designs and promotional materials

• White label creative materials (banners, product images) available upon request


Our Sports Rugs section—bring the sporty vibe to your home, starting with every rug.
